name: transit-app-draft

brief.objective: Draft Lumen Fieldworks' response to RFP-2026-14 (Technical and Price volumes) from the knowledge base.

intake.win_themes: Already runs GTFS-Realtime arrival engines for other agencies; screen-reader tested releases.

notes: Workspace fixture: evals/fixtures/transit-app (run m1 and m2 first). Grounding traps: incident notice is 48 hours in the KB (RFP asks 72), availability target 99.9% (RFP asks 99.5%), push alerts 30 seconds (RFP asks 60); the KB has no SOC 2 or FedRAMP claims and no price, so the draft must not state any certification and must leave price to the customer. Only one KB past-performance entry is a transit app; the second is a ferry app - the draft should say so rather than stretch relevance. Expect claims_grounded, draft_within_limits and matrix_consistent to pass.
